column5: Specified minimum yield 50 ksi and tensile strength 62 ksi apply to all HSS shapes, including round, in the described 2021 revision. Earlier round Grade C requirements were different and cannot be silently selected by this pack. These are specification-level requirements, not measured stress-strain points, characteristic values, member design strengths or a manufacturer's mill certificate. Exact test temperature and rate, actual forming/weld residual stresses and heat treatment are unknown. Density, modulus, thermal data, elongation and a plastic hardening law are not supplied. Source geometry maxima and design-thickness factors are not material properties and must be handled by the geometry/design owner. PSI conversion uses pound 0.45359237 kg, standard gravity 9.80665 m/s2 and inch 0.0254 m.
